findings: The public placeBet path accepts an arbitrary CREDIT_ONLY amount without token debit, scarce credit registry, authorization, signature, nonce, or atomic credit consumption, while a resolved winner can invoke TempleHeart.gamePayout for real KGEN.

Because each wallet gets one free position per round but wallet creation is unconstrained, an attacker can Sybil both UP and DOWN sides at no cost; every non-DRAW round then yields real KGEN until the round cap or TempleHeart 1888 survival floor blocks further payouts.

The direction-specific reward caps bound only a single round and are operator-configured; they do not prove reserved funds, budget authority, per-player entitlement, aggregate multi-round solvency, or economic loss for losing positions.

Current main TempleHeart lets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE replace fortuneGame immediately and gamePayout transfers real KGEN to the supplied player. The candidate therefore stops being a harmless simulation as soon as it is bound, even though its spec calls amounts test-credit weights.

TIME_ARROW_IMMUTABILITY is implementation-local, not protocol-immutable: UPGRADER_ROLE can replace the UUPS implementation after positions are placed, and the rehearsal assigns admin, operator, and upgrader to one wallet.

OPERATOR_ROLE can configure any code-bearing contract that mimics BTC / USD metadata and a fresh positive answer; no canonical feed registry, exact code or proxy identity, chain-bound manifest, governance delay, or independent authorization is enforced.

Oracle-unavailable cancellation trusts the snapshotted feed to revert and does not verify a canonical feed identity at cancellation time. A mutable or operator-controlled oracle can make an unfavorable whole round cancellable after the delay.

Resolution assumes the immediately preceding composite round ID exists and is the prior chronological update. Feed gaps or proxy-specific round behavior can make otherwise valid rounds permanently unresolvable without a reviewed liveness path.

The committed Testnet runner reads BSC_TESTNET_PRIVATE_KEY and BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL, funds new wallets, deploys contracts, upgrades a proxy, changes TempleHeart fortuneGame, and sends multiple chain transactions. It is a protected signer/deployment tool and must not be executed or transplanted automatically.

The rehearsal's real-chain labels prove only historical BSC Testnet observations using a deterministic mock oracle and a shared Testnet Heart. They do not prove Mainnet feed identity, signer authority, governance, budget, solvency, security, or deployment authorization.

The exact PR head has zero Actions runs, zero check runs, zero commit statuses, zero submitted reviews, zero review threads, and zero conversation comments; the 20/20 and 50/50 results are branch-authored claims rather than exact-head CI evidence.

The PR body expressly requires Human final review, the head is a codex/* branch, and the branch is 1016 commits behind current main. It is ineligible for automatic merge under both repository policy and the current automation boundary.
Five index and shared-tool paths conflict with current main or would overwrite current generated evidence, so the branch cannot be refreshed by simple merge or wholesale transplant.
No canonical FortuneGame address exists in current main, and no Mainnet deployment, Heart binding, oracle activation, economic parameter approval, or UI release authority is established.
positive_controls: The candidate does not escrow KGEN and labels its economic mode CREDIT_ONLY.
Positions are recorded atomically before the betting cutoff and current implementation has no individual edit or delete function.
Round economic, oracle, and Heart configuration is snapshotted at creation.
The current claim path is nonReentrant and marks claimed only after TempleHeart payout succeeds, preserving retryability on revert.
The candidate rejects pseudo-random outcome selection and attempts deterministic oracle-round proof checks.
The PR and evidence explicitly state MAINNET_DEPLOY = BLOCKED and do not embed a private key or authenticated RPC URL.
Current main does not contain the candidate FortuneGame contract, ABI, signer tool, or canonical deployment address.

limitations: No GitHub-hosted exact-head CI evidence exists.
The signer/deployment rehearsal was inspected statically and was not executed.
Branch-authored reports and self-authored security review are historical evidence, not independent review or current-main integration proof.

safe_successor_requirements: Replace free caller-selected credits with an authoritative scarce entitlement ledger whose issuance, signature, replay protection, debit, cancellation, and payout budget are atomically bound, or keep payouts test-only with no real token path.
Prove aggregate and per-round solvency, reserve or budget authorization, payout caps, Sybil resistance, and loss-bearing economics before any real TempleHeart binding.
Use an exact chain-bound canonical oracle manifest with proxy and implementation identity, freshness, heartbeat, phase/gap handling, revocation, and governance evidence.

Separate admin, operator, upgrader, oracle, and Heart authority with reviewed multisig/timelock controls and define whether immutability requires a non-upgradeable or irreversibly frozen implementation.
Keep all private-key, funding, deployment, upgrade, Heart-binding, and chain-write tooling outside automatic integration and require action-specific Human authorization.
Rebuild only on exact current main, preserve current generated evidence and indexes, and run exact-head contract, integration, adversarial-economic, storage-layout, and diff checks.
If a UI successor is later proposed, bind it to canonical network/deployment manifests and complete current-shell Chromium, responsive, accessibility, and 390x844 screenshot QA.
